charts.title: TOI-6699 b: orbits around TOI-6699
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-6699's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-6699 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lafarga et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag512L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAFARGA_ET_AL_2026): P 5.32005926761 d

charts.title: TOI-6699 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-6699 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (102, 103, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 341405597, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 28 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 431 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 10-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 28 min early; 10-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 144 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
